description: The fields an app accepts in create_draft / stage_changes (with an example). Call this before writing to an app. Apps that accept drafts: bundles (offers: create from a template, copy, move in the list, settings, who sees them / targeting; and kind 'look': the look shared by all popups + the store's Custom CSS, undoable), popups (campaigns + shop tools), sticky_cart (settings, checkout rules), the bar apps (bar settings), translate (settings, markets, Store translations settings, publish / unpublish a language and remove languages (these can be undone), and one-time translation actions: run / stop store translation, translate a selection, apply the glossary to existing translations (these two can't be undone), edit or revert a translation, find & replace, images by language, backups), accessibility (widget settings, menu link, monitoring + its frequency, report emails, statement details, and kind 'shop': automatic fixes, scans with What to scan / pages / theme, marking issues solved or open, AI alt text, statement page incl. adding the latest scan results, shopper reports) and page_speed (settings, and kind 'shop': everything its in-app assistant does: speed test, with / without compare, speed presets, SEO check, page by page check (+ redirect a broken link, forget the saved password), What to fix fixes, the app's on / off switches, image scans, compression / restore (products and theme / collection / blog images), alt text (products, collection and blog images), search titles and descriptions and their translations, internal links, image file names, clean URLs, llms.txt (preview / publish), redirects incl. broken links (404s) and redirect rules, robots.txt, hide a page from search, IndexNow, Google Search Console, AI agent readiness, AI visibility, rich results filled in from Shopify, App cleanup, stopping a job, and a card's Undo of a change made in the app).

app.description: Which EA app: sticky_cart = EA • Sticky Cart (cart drawer, sticky add-to-cart bar, quick buy, cart upsells, rewards / free-shipping goals, every editor setting incl. custom CSS / HTML and templates, cart A/B tests, cart translations, checkout payment / shipping method rules); bundles = EA • Bundles & Upsell (bundle deals, quantity breaks, upsell popups, checkout upsells); popups = EA • Email Popups (spin-to-win wheel and email / SMS sign-up popup campaigns); translate = EA • Auto Translate (store translation and language selector); accessibility = EA • Accessibility (accessibility widget and store accessibility scans); page_speed = EA • SEO & Page Speed (speed optimisations and SEO); free_shipping_bar = EA • Free Shipping Bar (free shipping progress bar); rewards_bar = EA • Gift & Rewards Bar (gift and rewards progress bar); announcement_bar = EA • Announcement Bar (announcement bar); countdown_bar = EA • Countdown Bar (countdown timer bar)

store.description: Which connected store (its myshopify address, e.g. other-store.myshopify.com). Leave it out for the default store; list_stores shows them.
